workflows.trigger: Herdr Android/Termux migration request or readiness evidence
steps: read AGENTS.md, harness doctrine, parent Android harness, Herdr manifest, codebase map and scoped skill
preserve tmux as canonical and product runtime files as read-only
resolve explicit or newest local herdr-readiness evidence
render Get-HerdrHarnessStatus.py classification
select reviewed-installation, failure-recovery, validation, or handoff at the first unproved gate
workflows.proofCeiling: routing from current evidence only; no installation approval or runtime promotion

steps: create herdr-install-review artifact with Build-HerdrInstallReview.py --write
bind review to current official upstream release/commit and install documentation
record exact artifact/package identity, integrity mechanism, supported platforms and explicit Android/Termux claim
reject undocumented cargo install, curl-pipe-shell proof, automatic device_config/battery mutation and tmux removal
record APPROVED, REJECTED, BLOCKED or PENDING plus rollback and exact next command
workflows.proofCeiling: a completed review may approve one bounded install method; it does not install Herdr or prove Android compatibility

steps: parse wrapper, probe and hooks with bash -n
run existing migration test and harness completeness test
run PowerShell completeness where available
run existing Android Termux portable floor
run git diff --check and verify generated evidence remains untracked/outside the repository
workflows.proofCeiling: tracked harness contracts only; not same-device runtime proof

workflows.trigger: probe, validator or migration gate failure
steps: preserve first bounded non-sensitive failure evidence
missing Herdr => keep tmux and route to reviewed-installation without improvising an installer
unhealthy binary => repair compatibility before server test
server/detach/agent-state/background/sprint failure => keep tmux and route to separately authorized live-runtime repair
tracked validator failure => repair inside harness scope and rerun the complete focused floor
render operator report with one next command
workflows.proofCeiling: failure boundary and evidence preservation only

workflows.trigger: focused validation completed or a real authority/runtime blocker remains
steps: run Get-HerdrHarnessStatus.py --write with explicit evidence when known
record repo/branch/head/PR and validator results separately from phone evidence
state working, broken/blocked, missing/unproved, proof reached and proof ceiling
provide one exact executable next command that advances the first unproved gate
keep credentials, device codes, private evidence and machine-local junk out of Git/PR
workflows.proofCeiling: handoff summarizes evidence; it is not additional installation/runtime/merge/deployment proof
